caveats: Experimental beta for Paseo 0.13+ (tested on 0.13.2). Tool cards need Full detail; they do not join Summary groups.
Before using Summary, run "Activity: use native tool rows" on that client; the choice resets to cards on reload.
Do not enable alongside another tool-call or Thinking timeline replacement.
Show all and serialization can be expensive for very large payloads.
macOS host and web client tested on 0.13.2; desktop app and native iOS/Android untested.
